deals.headline: Dietmar Hopp takes 96% of the voting rights under a DFL 50+1 exemption
deals.summary: After the DFL granted an exemption from the 50+1 rule in December 2014, the e.V.'s members voted in February 2015 to hand Hopp, until then holder of 49% of the voting shares, control of the professional company: from July 2015 he held 96% of the voting rights.

deals.date_text: Announced 1 March 2023; approved by members June 2023
deals.evidence: Diese geht ohne Entschädigung wieder zurück an den Mutterverein.
deals.headline: Hopp hands the voting majority back to the members' association without compensation
deals.summary: Hopp gave up his 50+1 exemption and returned the voting majority in the Spielbetriebs GmbH to the parent club, with no payment and no outflow of capital; he keeps 96% of the capital.

name: TSG 1899 Hoffenheim Fußball-Spielbetriebs GmbH
notes: tsg-hoffenheim.de blocks automated fetches (bunny.net shield), so the club's own pages are cited through web.archive.org captures. No revenue figure was found on a fetchable page: the DFL's published key figures for 2024/25 (group accounts, EUR thousands) give gross result (Rohergebnis) 169,401, personnel expense 94,870.6, result after tax -26,565.8 before a loss allocation of 27,754.2 to atypical silent partners, net result 1,099.7, equity 219,102.7 and liabilities 79,418.2; Rohergebnis is not revenue, so revenue is left null. Kicker (blocked) reported in July 2026 a further cash contribution by Hopp ('Hopp mit erneuter Millionengabe'), not recorded because the article could not be read. The 4% e.V. capital stake is widely reported but not stated on a page read here, so the e.V. stake is null. Stadium: renamed SNP Arena from 1 July 2026 (naming deal with SNP SE to 30 June 2028); capacity 30,150 is bundesliga.com's 2025/26 figure under the PreZero Arena name. Stadium owner not stated on a citable page (reportedly TSG 1899 Hoffenheim Fußball-Besitzgesellschaft mbH & Co. KG, a Hopp holding company). No valuation (not in Forbes 2026 or Football Benchmark European Elite 2026). The club has two managing directors and no single CEO.

owners.name: TSG 1899 Hoffenheim e.V. (members' association; holds the voting majority)

ownership_summary: The professional club is TSG 1899 Hoffenheim Fußball-Spielbetriebs GmbH (Amtsgericht Mannheim HRB 341926). SAP co-founder Dietmar Hopp holds 96% of its capital; he held 96% of the voting rights under a 50+1 exemption from July 2015 but returned the voting majority to the members' association TSG 1899 Hoffenheim e.V. without compensation in 2023, so the e.V. controls the votes while Hopp owns the equity.
